content.bridge_context: Exploring the ancient beliefs, languages, and traditions that formed the foundation of Indian culture.

units.title: What is Culture?
units.explanation: Culture includes language, food, music, and ways of living shared by a group.
units.dual_language_instruction: Name a festival your family celebrates. / एक त्यौहार का नाम बताएं जो आपका परिवार मनाता है।

units.title: Ancient Books
units.explanation: The Vedas are some of the oldest books in the world, written in Sanskrit.
units.dual_language_instruction: Have you heard of the Rigveda? / क्या आपने ऋग्वेद के बारे में सुना है?
